resources.string: Time-weighted average power of the active native Climber climb
Power-zone background with the time-weighted average of the active native Climber climb
Average power for your current climb.
Climb Power: average watts.\nClimb Power Zones: the same average with power-zone colors.
Add either field from PowerClimb when editing a data page in your ride profile.
Uses Karoo Climber. No setup needed.
